description: This file contains utility functions related to voice wake triggers and locale normalization for an application, likely for handling voice commands and localization in a macOS app.

methods.name: sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Processes an array of words to clean whitespace, limit the number and length of wake trigger words, returning a default set if the result is empty.

methods.name: normalizeLocaleIdentifier
methods.description: Sanitizes a locale identifier string by removing optional segments after '@', '-u-', and '-t-' markers.
